fixture.reference: Independent ARPACK shift-invert reference, seed 913, tol 1e-12, expanded basis
fixture.notes: Independent ARPACK shift-invert reference, seed 913, tol 1e-12, expanded basis; retain 6 known rigid modes and 100 nontrivial modes; ROM caller discards the known rigid block; full boundary cluster included

setup_scope: Preconditioner construction plus solver/operator/CG workspaces, input upload, and optional FP32 matrix copy. Excludes mesh assembly, reference loading, host random-start generation, graph capture and warmup. JIT work is included where encountered; these are not warmed setup measurements. Historical setup_seconds is an alias for preconditioner_setup_seconds.
memory_scope: Device free-memory decrease from after fixture preparation through preconditioner/workspace setup and capture. Includes allocator pools/runtime/JIT allocations; excludes original fixture storage and CuPy adapter. Not peak memory or a pure live-workspace count.
pool_memory_scope: Warp CUDA pool counters only, excluding driver/context allocations. The high-water counter covers the whole process, including fixture preparation; it is not the setup interval peak. Missing counters are null. Upstream FSAI can consume substantial device memory outside this pool.

graph.method: CUDA graph DOT inspection; not a CUDA API trace

rows.method: Warp BlockLOBPCG + device-bucketed CG + cached A X + device-bucketed search

quality.cg_iteration_accounting: Scheduled vector iterations in device-selected buckets, including within-bucket padding; fresh residuals may reactivate rows. Usage stores calls per bucket followed by total active RHSs.

cupy_adapter.reference_setup_scope: CuPy matrix/start/constraint upload, LinearOperator, and inner adapter workspaces/capture. Excludes supplied FSAI/base CG construction, library imports, and outer eigensolve warmup.
cupy_adapter.memory_scope: Device free-memory decrease during adapter setup, including graph/runtime allocations; not a peak measurement.
cupy_adapter.setup_scope: Extra inner adapter workspace/capture only. Shifted matrix and FSAI factors are shared with the completed Warp trial; active-width CG states are preallocated before timing. This is not independent end-to-end CuPy setup.
cupy_adapter.stopping: CuPy uses absolute residual tolerance and converges its entire starting block; independent original-problem gates check the first k modes. Warp uses normalized stopping on k modes.

timing_note: Warm replay wall times; setup/capture separate. CuPy converges its entire starting block; Warp stops on the first k. Contended or numerically rejected runs are not performance evidence.
